reforms.description: The government allocated 5G frequency bands in 2019 to facilitate the rollout of commercial services starting in 2020, aiming to enhance connectivity and support innovation in various sectors. Additionally, a framework for project-based regulatory sandboxes was created in 2018 to foster innovation by allowing businesses to test new technologies and services in a controlled environment. The government has also revised the Feed-in Tariffs (FITs) and introduced reverse tendering for large-scale solar energy projects to enhance renewable energy generation.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These reforms are designed to enhance connectivity and support innovation, which are expected to raise productivity and efficiency in various sectors.
reforms.status_evidence: The 5G frequency allocation and regulatory sandbox framework have been implemented, as well as the revisions to the Feed-in Tariffs.
reforms.importance_rationale: While these reforms are significant in promoting innovation, they do not represent a structural overhaul of the innovation system.
reforms.source_quote: Preferential treatment in public procurement will be granted for advanced technology and SMEs and venture businesses.

reforms.description: A framework for project-based regulatory sandboxes was created in 2018 to foster innovation by allowing businesses to test new technologies and services in a controlled environment.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This reform encourages innovation by providing a controlled environment for testing, which can lead to increased productivity and technological advancement.
reforms.status_evidence: The regulatory sandbox framework has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: The regulatory sandbox framework is significant for innovation but does not represent a major overhaul of the system.
reforms.source_quote: A framework for project-based regulatory sandboxes was created in 2018.

reforms.description: The guideline for the strategic basic technology advancement/collaboration support projects was revised in 2018 to expand its coverage to include R&D projects related to AI and IoT between SMEs and universities and government research institutes.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This reform aims to enhance collaboration in R&D, which is expected to drive innovation and productivity in key technology sectors.
reforms.status_evidence: The revised guidelines have been implemented to support R&D projects.
reforms.importance_rationale: The revision of guidelines is significant for promoting collaboration but does not represent a major structural change.
reforms.source_quote: In 2018, the guideline for the strategic basic technology advancement/collaboration support projects was revised and its coverage expanded to include R&D projects related to AI and IoT between SMEs and universities and government research institutes.

reforms.description: Japan is promoting the development of technologies to improve power generation efficiency and drastically reduce GHG emissions, in part through carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS).
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This initiative aims to enhance technological capabilities in energy production, which can lead to improved efficiency and reduced emissions, supporting sustainable growth.
reforms.status_evidence: The promotion of technologies for power generation efficiency has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: While significant, this initiative does not represent a major overhaul of the energy sector's R&D framework.
reforms.source_quote: Japan is promoting the development of technologies to improve power generation efficiency and drastically reduce GHG emissions, in part through carbon capture, utilisation and storage (CCUS).

reforms.description: Osaka Prefecture promotes the creation of a biomedical innovation cluster by lifting the ban on businesses run by professors at national universities, fostering collaboration between academia and industry.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This reform is expected to enhance collaboration and innovation in the biomedical sector, leading to economic growth and improved health outcomes.
reforms.status_evidence: The lifting of the ban on businesses run by professors has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant structural change in the regulatory environment for biomedical innovation.
reforms.source_quote: In 2004, the national government approved Osaka Prefecture’s proposal to designate a district in its northern area as a Structural Reform Special Zone to promote the creation of a biomedical innovation cluster.

reforms.description: Osaka Prefecture has established local special zones where the corporate income tax rate is cut to zero for approved life science or alternative energy businesses, promoting growth in these sectors.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: These tax incentives are designed to attract businesses in life sciences and alternative energy, which can stimulate economic growth and innovation.
reforms.status_evidence: The establishment of local special zones with tax incentives has been implemented.
reforms.importance_rationale: While beneficial, these tax incentives do not represent a major overhaul of the economic framework.
reforms.source_quote: Osaka Prefecture promotes growth through local special zones in which the local corporate income tax rate is cut to as low as zero for approved life science or alternative energy businesses.
